第4章老丑下山冰美人送货上门（第1页）
老丑刚入宅院。一声娇喝在耳边炸开。
剑光迎面而来。侧身剑贴着脖颈过去，血痕乍现。
是个女子，脸冷着。容颜娇美，眉宇带狠。
虽比不上苏若雪绝色，却别有味道。是个冰美人。
这段时间一直被人欺辱，又压抑着浴火，突见来了这样一个大美人，心中火热，眼中闪过一丝精光。
“我正xun欢不找，你倒是送上门来！”
心念转动下。老丑一边狼狈招架，一边观察剑路。
忽地盯住她剑柄。碧玉剑穗。诈语道。
“不错。我便是碧落游仙宫大弟子萧月娥。”她顿了顿，“不知前辈高姓大名？”
萧月娥乃半步先天境。游历至此。正遇那采花淫贼白小楼，虽击杀了对方，却不知自己已中了y毒。
老丑拱手：“贱名不足挂齿，眼下在锁仙宫当差。久闻萧仙子大名，不曾想今日得见，荣幸万分。”
“锁仙宫？”萧月娥自是知晓。敌意稍减，但手上宝剑仍保持封锁。“那，前辈为何夜闯民宅？”
“这是那臭名昭著的采花淫贼白小楼的宅子。难不成你也是那淫贼一党？”萧月娥一指暗角人头，不是白小楼尸首又是何人？
说罢剑锋一扬，又欲搏杀。老丑心中大急，自认单打独斗绝非是其敌手。脚步往后轻退，赶忙摆手解释。
“萧仙子，误会啊。误会。我与那白小楼有断指之仇，此番你替天行道，为民除害，小老儿佩服得紧。”
下一瞬，老丑忽地右手一弹，指劲携带一团白色粉末直射她面门。
萧月娥不曾想对方竟使如此下三滥的手段，惊退之际，但还是慢了一步。

心知不妙，抽身欲退。运转玄力挽起剑花，斩向老丑手腕。但药粉已吸入，脑袋还是一晕。手腕一沉，佩剑被卸。
突发此变，失了兵刃，心神不由得大乱。见老丑逼近，不敢恋战，转身便逃。
若非她先中了淫毒此刻又中迷药，凭老丑这点微末道行，哪能如此逼迫。
萧月娥脚步虚浮，踉跄欲倒。后领忽感一紧，已被抓住。大惊之下用力一挣。
衣领裂开。顾不上害羞，又气又怒，身子急冲，只想逃离。
老丑抓到一条布条。鼻尖轻闻，一股处子柔香。布条往空中一丢，快步赶上。
萧月娥慌忙跑进院子。老丑又追了上来。缠斗间，衣衫撕裂声持续。
眼看步步紧逼，萧月娥一咬牙，怒喝道：“好个丑老鬼，竟敢如此欺我。姑奶奶和你拼了！”
萧月娥勉强站直，摆出架势。刚才打斗中，老丑早已欲火难耐。
此刻见她不跑，倒也省事。正中老丑下怀！
老丑哈哈一笑：“今晚便要你流血！”
萧月娥银牙暗咬，运转玄力，向着老丑打去。但下一刻，后心一痛。玄力顷刻涣散。

Chapter 4 The old ugly comes down the mountain and the ice beauty delivers the goods to your door (page 1)
Lao Chou has just entered the house. A loud shout exploded in my ears.
The sword light came towards me. The sideways sword was pressed against his neck, and blood marks suddenly appeared.
It was a woman, with a cold face. She has a pretty face and fierce eyebrows.
Although it is not as beautiful as Su Ruoxue, it has a different flavor. She is an ice beauty.
During this period of time, I had been bullied and suppressed, but when I suddenly saw such a beautiful woman, I felt hot in my heart and a glimmer of light flashed in my eyes.
"I was just looking for pleasure, but you brought it to my door!"
The mind turns. The old Chou was fighting in embarrassment while observing the path of the sword.
Suddenly he stared at the hilt of her sword. Jasper sword spike. Liar said.
"Yes. I am Xiao Yue'e, the senior disciple of Biluo Youxian Palace." She paused, "I don't know your senior's surname?"
Xiao Yue'e is half a step into the innate realm. Traveled here. They met Bai Xiaolou, the prostitute who picked flowers. Although he killed him, he didn't know that he had been poisoned.
Lao Chou cupped his hands and said, "My humble name is not worth mentioning. I am currently working as an errand in Suo Xian Palace. I have heard about Fairy Xiao's name for a long time, but I never expected to see her today. I am extremely honored."
"Lock Immortal Palace?" Xiao Yue'e knew it. The hostility subsided slightly, but the sword in hand remained sealed. "Then, why did Senior break into a house at night?"
"This is the house of the notorious flower-picking thief Bai Xiaolou. Is it possible that you are also part of that thief?" Xiao Yue'e pointed at the head in the dark corner. Who could it be if it wasn't Bai Xiaolou's body?
After saying that, he raised his sword and wanted to fight again. Lao Chou was very worried and thought that he would never be his opponent if he fought alone. He stepped back slightly and quickly waved his hand to explain.
"Xianxian Xiao, there is a misunderstanding. A misunderstanding. I have a grudge against that Bai Xiaolou who broke off my finger. This time you have done justice for heaven and eliminated harm for the people. I admire you very much."
The next moment, Lao Chou suddenly flicked his right hand, carrying a ball of white powder with his fingers and shooting it directly at her face.
Xiao Yue'e never thought that the other party would use such a despicable method. When she retreated in fright, she still took a step slower.
I knew something was wrong and wanted to retreat. Using my profound energy, I picked up the sword flower and slashed towards the old Chou's wrist. But after inhaling the powder, my head was still dizzy. His wrist sank, and the sword was removed.
This sudden change caused him to lose his weapon and his mind was in a state of confusion. Seeing Lao Chou approaching, he didn't dare to fight, so he turned around and ran away.
If she hadn't been poisoned first and then drugged at the same time, how could the old Chou be so coercive with his meager behavior?
Xiao Yue'e's steps were frivolous and she was about to fall. The back collar suddenly felt tight and had been caught. Shocked, he struggled hard.
Collar split. I couldn't care less about being shy, I was angry and angry, my body was rushing, I just wanted to escape.
The old man caught a strip of cloth. Smell it gently on the tip of your nose, and you can smell the soft fragrance of virginity. Throwing the strip of cloth into the air, he quickly caught up.
Xiao Yue'e hurriedly ran into the yard. The old man caught up with him again. During the struggle, the sound of clothes tearing continued.
Seeing that he was getting closer and closer, Xiao Yue'e gritted her teeth and shouted angrily: "What an ugly old ghost, how dare you bully me like this. My aunt will fight with you!"
Xiao Yue'e reluctantly stood up straight and took a posture. During the fight just now, Lao Chou was already horny.
It would save trouble if she didn't run away at this moment. Playing into the old Chou's hands!
The old man laughed and said, "I will make you bleed tonight!"
Xiao Yue'e bit her silver teeth secretly and used her mysterious power to hit Lao Chou. But the next moment, my heart ached. My profound strength instantly dissipated.
